def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rs = [i for i in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[i])]
    cs = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 8 for i in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rs + [h], [-1] + cs + [w]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

        for rr,cc in targets:
            for r in range(rb[rr]+1,rb[rr+1]):
                for c in range(cb[cc]+1,cb[cc+1]): out[r][c] = color
    return out
